name: RMD-MP
savepath: This is a fairly large patch that adds a new 'Marketplace' feature to enable offline trading, as well as new QoL features and bug fixes. For more info about the Marketplace, please visit d2rmodding.com. Enjoy the update!

D2RHUD has continued to receive substantial upgrades, adding a dozen new features, including a new Marketplace for offline trading. Several performance improvements and bug fixes were also included. For a full changelog, visit our Discord!
